sealed_signatures: theorem interference_branches {alpha : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha] (z s : alpha -> Complex) (x : alpha) : interferenceOutput z s (x, 0) = (1 + z x) * s x / 2 ∧ interferenceOutput z s (x, 1) = -Complex.I * (1 - z x) * s x / 2

theorem sampled_branches {alpha : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha] (f : alpha -> Real) (tau : Real) (s : alpha -> Complex) (x : alpha) : sampledOutput f tau s (x, 0) = (1 + sampledPhase f tau x) * s x / 2 ∧ sampledOutput f tau s (x, 1) = -Complex.I * (1 - sampledPhase f tau x) * s x / 2

theorem constant_branches {alpha : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha] (c tau : Real) (s : alpha -> Complex) (x : alpha) : sampledOutput (fun _ => c) tau s (x, 0) = (1 + Complex.exp((((-tau*c : Real) : Complex)*Complex.I))) * s x / 2 ∧ sampledOutput (fun _ => c) tau s (x, 1) = -Complex.I * (1 - Complex.exp((((-tau*c : Real) : Complex)*Complex.I))) * s x / 2
theorem omitted_constant_zero {alpha : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq alpha] (s : alpha -> Complex) (x : alpha) : interferenceOutput (fun _ => 1) s (x, 1) = 0
